collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TALL TALES AND SELF-INTEREST (TT-01 to TT-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Boasting, stretched stories, little vanities, wanting the credit, the best seat or the bigger half. Most of it is harmless and funny; kind people can be boastful too. Nobody is exposed for the sake of it, and nobody needs a lesson.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager's famous fish stew has a secret ingredient, but a friend sees only salt go in: ask about it, or keep the secret.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Everyone agrees that (subject)'s fish stew is the best on Isola, and (subject) always says it's because of a secret ingredient. (subject.He/she) will not say what it is. Today (friend) watches (subject.him/her) make it, from start to finish, and sees nothing unusual go in at all, except one extra pinch of salt.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Was that it? The salt?" (subject) looks around carefully and whispers: "The secret ingredient is telling people there's a secret ingredient. Then they taste it harder." (friend) is outraged and impressed in equal parts. The stew, as always, is excellent.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) says nothing. At the next feast, someone praises the stew and asks (subject) about the secret. (subject) smiles mysteriously. (friend), across the fire, smiles mysteriously too. Now there are two people who won't say what it is, and the stew is twice as famous.
